scope: X-04 plant selection, history/comparison, stable archive IDs; X-02 advisory live preview; safe in-place device update; achievement disable setting respected by main-screen saves
commands: adb -s b861c4e0 shell am instrument -w -r -e class <selected classes below> com.agronomy.phytomonitor.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner

device.migration: Installed database v1 to v3; original photo/detection/inspection/plot rows preserved
coverage: comparison by date and activity recreation
plot create/rename/confirm deletion on owned fixture
real camera preview sampling, disable/enable and disposal

preservation.note: DataStore bytes changed only by adding achievements=true; all original preference values match. Database bytes necessarily changed by migration and test events.

limitations: Device actions use injected recognized commands and Compose; independent live Russian speech, headset and TalkBack are not established by these tests.
Real scene guidance accuracy, false warnings, temperature, energy and latency require labeled field measurements.
Preview uses whole-frame luminance heuristics, not leaf localization or diagnostic confidence.
Current APK models remain unchanged; no training or model release.

evidence.initial_device_failures: device.log (owned-fixture cleanup and test wait for journal loading; fixed and re-run)
evidence.test_award_cleanup: award_cleanup.log (only the complete_record award generated by the owned synthetic observation; absent before testing)
